info.languageHint: The language you speak on stream. Twitch shows it to viewers.
info.labelsHint: Twitch shows these to viewers. Switch on what your stream has.

label.brandedHint: Tells viewers the stream has a paid sponsor or ad.
label.MatureGameHint: Twitch sets this from your category.

platforms.title: Where it goes
platforms.description: Your stream info goes to every platform you connect.

checklist.title: Before you go live
checklist.titleMissing: Set a title and a category

checklist.botOut: The bot is not in chat
checklist.rewardsUnavailable: Channel points are not available on this channel
checklist.rewardsOff: Off or paused: {titles}. {n} of {m} rewards are on.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: The streams you plan on Twitch.
schedule.vacationHint: Twitch hides your schedule during a vacation.
schedule.vacationInvalid: Pick a start and an end after it to save.
schedule.segmentHint: A segment is one planned stream.
schedule.deleteDescription: The segment is removed from your Twitch schedule. Cancel keeps it and only skips one stream.
schedule.deleteSeries: Every week of this repeating segment is removed.

raidNow.title: Raid a channel
raidNow.description: Send your viewers to another channel. Twitch counts down before the raid begins, and you can cancel until then.
raidNow.lookupError: Twitch could not be asked. Try again.
raidNow.confirmDescription: Your viewers go to this channel when the countdown ends, and your stream ends for them. Cancel raid stops it until then.
raidNow.started: The raid to {name} is counting down.
raidNow.startError: The raid to {name} could not start.
raidNow.cancelError: There is no raid to cancel.

raids.title: Raid rules
raids.description: How the bot ranks channels to raid. Your rules, only for this channel.
raids.error: The raid rules could not load.
raids.intro: Higher points are suggested first. A rule at 0 does nothing.
raids.preferredCategoriesHint: Give points when a channel plays one of these games. The first match counts.
raids.keywords: Words in the title or tags
raids.keywordsHint: Give points when the stream title or tags hold one of your words. The first rule that matches counts.
raids.viewerBandsHint: Give points by how many viewers a channel has right now. The first band that fits counts.
raids.recency: How long ago you raided them
raids.recencyHint: Raiding the same channel again and again gets old. Give less for a recent raid, more for an old one.
raids.balanceHint: Give points for raids you owe each other, and for channels you follow.
raids.reasonPlaceholder: Short reason, like Plays games you like
raids.neverRaided: A channel you never raided gives
raids.olderRaids: Raided longer ago than every step above gives
raids.owedBase: They raided you more than you raided them: the first raid you owe gives
raids.owedExtra: Each further raid you owe adds
raids.reciprocal: You and them are even: gives
raids.label: Reason shown
raids.addWord: Type a word and press Enter

problems.weight-out-of-range: Points must stay between -{limit} and {limit}. Now: {value}.
problems.category-no-name: Pick a category for this rule.
problems.keyword-no-words: Add at least one word to this keyword.
problems.keyword-empty-word: One of the words is empty. Remove it.
problems.keyword-matches-nothing: Turn on tags or title, or this keyword never matches.
problems.band-below-zero: The minimum viewers cannot be below {limit}. Now: {value}.
problems.band-min-above-max: The minimum ({value}) is above the maximum ({limit}).
problems.step-needs-day: A step needs at least {limit} day. Now: {value}.

clips.empty: Twitch lists no clips for your channel.
clips.uploaded: The clip is on your YouTube channel.

upload.title: Upload this clip to YouTube
upload.description: The clip goes to your own YouTube channel as a video.

refused.not_connected: This channel is not connected to YouTube. Connect it under connected services first.
refused.not_allowed: YouTube refused the upload for your account. Connect YouTube again and allow the bot to manage your account.
refused.clip_unavailable: Twitch gave no download for this clip. The bot needs your permission to manage clips on Twitch.
refused.limit_reached: The YouTube upload limit for today is used up. Try again tomorrow.
refused.failed: The upload did not finish. Try again.
